## The missing layer between your data & your AI

It all comes together in one platform—knowledge graphs, data observability, conversational
analytics, and contract-first governance—so AI can scale with accuracy and control.
* Jump to card card1:Context layer
* Jump to card card2:Trust layer
* Jump to card card3:Access layer

Context layer

Federated knowledge graph gives every asset a semantic identity, so AI understands business meaning,
not just column names. Bottom-up cataloging across all sources, with a Steward Agent to maintain
definitions and contract-first governance.

Trust layer

Continuous monitoring is built into the platform. It validates data health in real time, enforces
data contracts, and provides AI agents with automated trust signals, enabling them to operate
without human checkpoints.

Access layer

Natural language interface (NL-to-SQL), context-aware and embedded in workflows, lets business users
query data in Slack or Teams, delivering instant, governed answers through approved templates and
real-time validation.

The Observation

## Enterprise AI fails not because of the model, but because of missing context

We've spent years studying how enterprises deploy AI agents. The pattern is consistent: teams build
impressive prototypes, but hit a wall when moving to production.

The wall isn't the models. It’s that no agent can reason effectively about a business it doesn't
understand — what your data means, how your teams work, how your company defines "revenue" compared
to the rest of the world.

Key Insight

When every organization has access to the same intelligence, **context becomes the differentiator**.
The enterprise that best articulates its own knowledge — its data, its processes, its meaning — will
build AI that's most useful to its people.

“We built a revenue analysis agent and it couldn't answer one question. We started to realize we
were missing this translation layer. We had no way to interpret human language against the structure
of the data.”

Joe DosSantos

VP, Enterprise Data & Analytics

## How we support you

### Research

BARC user surveys, software evaluations and expert-driven content help organizations make confident
decisions.

Our independent research cuts through market complexity, rigorously evaluates software, vendors and
service providers, and shows organizations how to turn data, analytics and AI into real business
impact.

### Events

Every year, over 13,000 data & analytics experts meet at BARC conferences, roundtables and webinars.
Our events offer information, inspiration and direct exchange.

Participants learn from peers who face the same challenges and have already solved them, and leave
with concrete strategies for their organization.

### Consulting

BARC Consulting translates companies’ requirements into future-proof decisions. Our analysts combine
research, practical experience and a comprehensive market overview.

They guide organizations from data & analytics strategy and culture through the right technology and
architecture to optimized, data-driven business processes. With no conflict of interest.

research, practical experience and a comprehensive market overview.

architecture to optimized, data-driven business processes. With no conflict of interest.

# Structured Industrial Access to Latin America for Global Manufacturers

Latin America is not a market to explore. It is a region that requires structure, qualified
representation, and a defined operational pathway. ConectNext functions as a strategic bridge
enabling industrial manufacturers and solution providers to establish a credible and effective
presence across the region.

ConectNext is not a traditional directory. It is an integrated expansion platform that combines
regional visibility, governed representation, and on-the-ground execution within a unified
operational ecosystem. We work with international companies seeking to enter and scale in Latin
America, enabling structured access to relevant decision-makers, distributors, industrial buyers,
and institutional counterparts across more than 23 strategic sectors, including Industrial
Machinery, AgriTech, Pharma, Energy, Logistics, and Advanced Materials.

Latin America encompasses a market of more than 670 million people and a combined GDP exceeding USD
6.4 trillion, representing one of the world’s most dynamic growth environments. However, successful
market entry requires far more than commercial intent. It demands local presence, regulatory
clarity, cultural alignment, and trusted operational frameworks.

Through ConectNext, organizations gain structured access to the region, supported by qualified
representation, sector-specific intelligence, and a vetted operational network. This approach
ensures that expansion into Latin America is strategic, scalable, and aligned with real commercial
opportunity — not speculation.

The platform’s full structural definition is outlined in [What Is ConectNext][19].

## Why ConectNext Is the Strategic Choice for Expansion into Latin America

ConectNext is built specifically for manufacturers, industrial technology providers, and B2B
solution firms that require a structured and reliable entry into Latin America. Expanding into the
region is not simply a commercial initiative — it is an operational decision that demands market
clarity, controlled risk, and local presence. ConectNext centralizes these capabilities within a
single, integrated expansion hub.

Our platform aligns market access, regional visibility, commercial representation, and operational
execution under one coordinated framework. This enables companies to evaluate, enter, and expand in
Latin America without opening a local office, committing to high upfront investment, or navigating

## Your controls run the whole lifecycle

Most risk tools are built around their own logic.
Coverbase is built around yours.

Coverbase spans six stages of the vendor lifecycle: intake, zero-touch assessment, risk copilot,
continuous monitoring, inspection, and contracts. Each stage feeds the others. Intake improves
assessment. Assessment powers risk decisions. Risk insights shape monitoring and inspection.
Inspection and monitoring refine contract terms. Contract obligations define what gets tracked.
Signals loop back into intake and reassessment. The longer Coverbase runs, the more it mirrors how
your team evaluates risk. This is not a workflow tool. It’s infrastructure that compounds.

Stage 1

### Autonomous Intake

Know exactly who you're onboarding before you ask a single question.

Coverbase researches every new supplier automatically -- scanning public attack surface, financials,
OFAC, adverse media, and product data -- then pre-fills your inherent risk questionnaire so your
team reviews, not re-enters.

Stage 2

### Zero-touch Assessments

Fully assess low-risk vendors without sending a single questionnaire.

Coverbase pulls from security, compliance, legal, financial, and registration APIs automatically --
reading trust centers, public filings, and paid data sources -- so your team gets a completed
assessment, not a blank form to route.

Stage 3

### Risk Assessment Copilot

Accelerate third-party risk assessments by 92%.

Automatically analyze questionnaires, contracts, and third-party evidence against your custom
controls. Detect exceptions, generate follow-ups -- and train the model on your team's decisions so
every assessment gets faster and more accurate over time.

Stage 4

### Supplier Radar

Continuously monitor suppliers across every risk domain.

Combine internal and external feeds into a third-party SIEM to detect supplier issues early, trigger
automated outreach, confirm blast radius, and close the case -- with every incident feeding back
into assessments, contracts, and risk scores.

## Your controls run the whole lifecycle

Most risk tools are built around their own logic.
Coverbase is built around yours.

Coverbase spans six stages of the vendor lifecycle: intake, zero-touch assessment, risk copilot,
continuous monitoring, inspection, and contracts. Each stage feeds the others. Intake improves
assessment. Assessment powers risk decisions. Risk insights shape monitoring and inspection.
Inspection and monitoring refine contract terms. Contract obligations define what gets tracked.
Signals loop back into intake and reassessment. The longer Coverbase runs, the more it mirrors how
your team evaluates risk. This is not a workflow tool. It’s infrastructure that compounds.

Stage 1

### Autonomous Intake

Know exactly who you're onboarding before you ask a single question.

Coverbase researches every new supplier automatically -- scanning public attack surface, financials,
OFAC, adverse media, and product data -- then pre-fills your inherent risk questionnaire so your
team reviews, not re-enters.

Stage 2

### Zero-touch Assessments

Fully assess low-risk vendors without sending a single questionnaire.

Coverbase pulls from security, compliance, legal, financial, and registration APIs automatically --
reading trust centers, public filings, and paid data sources -- so your team gets a completed
assessment, not a blank form to route.

Stage 3

### Risk Assessment Copilot

Accelerate third-party risk assessments by 92%.

Automatically analyze questionnaires, contracts, and third-party evidence against your custom
controls. Detect exceptions, generate follow-ups -- and train the model on your team's decisions so
every assessment gets faster and more accurate over time.

Stage 4

### Supplier Radar

Continuously monitor suppliers across every risk domain.

Combine internal and external feeds into a third-party SIEM to detect supplier issues early, trigger
automated outreach, confirm blast radius, and close the case -- with every incident feeding back
into assessments, contracts, and risk scores.

## **Agent-Ready**** by Design**

## Agent-Ready by Design

The next generation of media workflows won't be driven only by people in UIs — they'll be executed
by autonomous agents working through governed machine interfaces. Fabric's platforms are built for
both. Every product line exposes an MCP server with OAuth-governed access — each agent identity's
permissions determine the tools it can use — alongside documented REST APIs, webhooks, and
machine-readable documentation.

### [Xytech X2 MCP][21]

Agents create and update orders, schedule resources, and drive media workflows through the X2 MCP
server — with OAuth permissions scoped per tool, so enterprises delegate exactly the operational
authority they choose.

### [Origin Studio MCP][22]

One unified MCP server across Origin Studio and Nexus. Agents query source-of-truth title metadata
and execute catalog operations, with OAuth rights dictating tool access per identity.

### [Origin Insights MCP][23]

Governed natural-language access to 1.5B+ market data points across 1,000+ platforms and 249
countries. OAuth-based, built for elastic agent workloads.

REST APIs with machine-readable schemas · Webhooks and event-driven workflows · llms.txt and
markdown docs for agent consumption · Tool-level OAuth governance · ISO/IEC 27001 certified

## Strategic Partners for Your Most Important Data & AI Initiatives

We’re not developers. We’re not just consultants. We’re your strategic business partners with
unrivaled experience and expertise across the Microsoft Data Stack.

Collectiv is a Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI), Microsoft Fabric Featured Partner,
Databricks Consulting Partner, a Select Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network Services
Track, and G2’s top-rated Microsoft consulting firm. Our experts have a true understanding of how to
interlink architecture, analytics, and AI to drive successful data initiatives.

Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Copilot, and Claude are the tools that will make an impact on your
journey and the tools that we specialize in. As your partner, Collectiv empowers informed
data-driven decisions throughout your organization.

## Single & Double Bedsheet

Bedsheets are one of the most essential decorative elements in your room, possessing a unique
aesthetic charm of their own. Nowadays, bedsheets have become a true reflection of a home's style.
People select bedsheets based on the specific ambiance of their room and their personal mood.
Therefore, a store that offers high quality, vibrant colors, and reliable products serves as the
ideal destination for them.

We offer an extensive range of bedsheets, distinguished by their superior quality, diverse designs,
and rich color palettes. Our product line includes Jaipuri bedsheets, Indigo block-printed
bedsheets, Sanganeri bedsheets, and various other printed cotton varieties. All of these are
available in a comprehensive range of sizes to fit double beds, single beds, and divans.

Based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, we are a renowned manufacturer of both single and double bedsheets. We
also accept bulk orders for our cotton bedsheets. We invite you to explore our exclusive collection,
which features **[Jaipuri hand-block printed bedsheets][64]**, **[Luxury Cotton Bags][65]**, and

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# NMDB: the Neutron Monitor Database

Real-Time Database for high-resolution Neutron Monitor measurements


## one stop shop for cosmic ray data

NMDB provides access to Neutron Monitor measurements from stations around the world. The goal of
NMDB is to provide easy access to all Neutron Monitor measurements through an easy to use interface.
NMDB provides access to real-time as well as historical data.

NMDB distributes official data provided by the PIs of the neutron monitor stations. Data of
different origin may not have been validated or authorised by the respective PI, and any deviation
with respect to the authorised data is not his/her responsibility.

Data retrieved via NMDB are the property of the individual data providers. These data are free for
non commercial use within the restrictions imposed by the providers. If you use such data for your
research or applications, please acknowledge the origin by a sentence like “We acknowledge the NMDB
database [www.nmdb.eu][13], founded under the European Union's FP7 programme (contract no. 213007)
for providing data.", and acknowledge individual monitors following the information given on the
respective station information page (see sub-pages under [www.nmdb.eu][14]).

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]

across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

customers to better understand trade around the globe.

are involved in the shipment of goods.

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

management.

Duplicate Cleaner can quickly locate and remove duplicate files on your PC and external drives,
instantly freeing up storage space. It helps you effortlessly identify unnecessary copies hiding in
every folder, clean up clutter, and make room for new data.

MiniTool partition manager software offers two perfect solutions for data recovery. Partition
Recovery Wizard can find and recover the lost partitions while Data Recovery feature can recognize
and recover lost/deleted files from damaged, formatted, inaccessible FAT/NTFS/exFAT drives and
Desktop/Recycle Bin/specified folders.

cloning works perfectly when you are forced to make an instant backup. System migration returns you
to act on the new disk in a while. No need to spend hours reinstalling operating system and
applications.

analyze disk usage on computer, verify the file system integrity of a volume and fix logical file
system errors, and quickly detect if there are bad sectors on the drive.

## **What Makes Data ****Agentic-Ready****?**

AI agents are only as trustworthy as the data they act on. Most enterprise data isn’t ready.
Agentic-Ready Data is visible, reliable, accountable, and complete.  That’s the higher standard AI
needs to operate with confidence.

[1 icon]

### UNIFIEDMake your data visible

Enterprise data exists across every signal and every system, but not always in a way AI can see or
understand. Make it available, connected, and easy to navigate so AI can discover and use it
wherever decisions are made.

[2 icon]

### HIGH QUALITYMake your data reliable

Agents move fast, and AI doesn’t pause to validate bad inputs. Keep your data accurate, complete,
consistent, and continuously monitored so every AI decision starts with trusted information.

[3 icon]

### GOVERNEDMake your data accountable

As AI starts acting on your behalf, transparency and control become non-negotiable. Make every AI
decision based on data that is traceable, explainable, and governed by business policies, so AI
operates responsibly.

[4 icon]

### ENRICHEDMake your data complete

Your internal data alone isn’t enough for agentic AI. Adding rich location, business, and consumer
context gives AI the complete picture it needs to understand, reason, and act with confidence.

[Link icon]

Data must meet all these conditions continuously, wherever decisions are made. The Precisely Data
Integrity Suite makes your data AI-ready in one unified system, so agents can drive business
outcomes at enterprise scale.

What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

Comfort|Design|Color|Performance|Sustainability|
We elevate every experience through innovative design - blending beauty, comfort, and performance to
set new standards for how materials enhance the way we live, work, and connect.
[Explore Markets][68]
[View Collections][69]
The home of *award-winning* performance fabrics.
For half a century, Ultrafabrics has continually reinvented the world of animal-free performance
fabrics by pairing uncompromising craftsmanship with cutting-edge innovation test.

Our premium and intelligent fabrics elevate your senses in every way, while delivering unmatched
benefits in durability, cleanability, breathability and more.
[About Us][70]
* [Cabernet]
  
  # Brisa
  
  High-comfort meets high-functionality with Brisa. Diverse shades and a softly textured grain
  combine to make a go-to choice for interior projects — from upholstery to vertical and horizontal
  paneling. Ultrafabrics’ proprietary ventilation system promotes airflow for ultimate seating
  comfort, and notable acoustic properties help reduce noise when paired with appropriate
  components. 
  
  Brisa’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
   
* [Breathable Distressed]
  
  # Brisa Distressed
  
  Brisa Distressed delivers a rustic, natural grain aesthetic with all the performance benefits that
  define our renowned Brisa collection. Engineered with breathable airflow technology, it delivers
  lasting comfort, reduced noise with its unique acoustic properties, and exceptional durability.
  Offered in a palette of earthy hues, Brisa Distressed suits a wide range of interior applications
  —from upholstery to vertical and horizontal panels.
  
  Brisa Distressed’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon.
  Each linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Breathable Forecast]
  
  # Brisa Forecast
  
  Boundary-pushing performance is the hallmark of Brisa Forecast. Climate control technology shields
  against temperature changes while breathability provides ultimate seating comfort and softness.
  Featuring water repellency, EPA-registered mildew defense, solar endurance, and colorfastness,
  it’s ideal for outdoor residential applications.
  
  Between its subtly textured aesthetic and palette of classic shades, Brisa Forecast brings
  understated style to any space — indoors or outdoors.
  
  Brisa Forecast’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each
  linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
  
  *Formally known as Brisa Original Outdoor. Outdoor applications for Residential use only.*
